tools.name: startEvalabChatTool
tools.description:
Start a new chat session for a specific domain. Each session tracks progress through domain-specific workflows using tasks. Returns a sessionId for continuing the conversation and monitoring completion.

⚠️  VALIDATION ERRORS: This tool returns validation errors when the LLM generates invalid output. Always check hasValidationErrors in the response before assuming success. Validation errors indicate schema violations, invalid task states, or content integrity failures.

SESSION LIFECYCLE:
1. START: Create session with initial message (this tool)
2. CONTINUE: Send additional messages using continue-evalab-chat
3. MONITOR: Check progress using get-evalab-session
4. COMPLETE: All tasks complete, result available
5. RETRIEVE: Get final output using get-session-result

USE THIS WHEN:
- Starting a new conversation in any domain
- Beginning a multi-step workflow
- Creating a session for first-time interaction
- Testing domain functionality

DO NOT USE WHEN:
- Continuing an existing session (use continue-evalab-chat instead)
- Checking session status (use get-evalab-session instead)
- Retrieving completed results (use get-session-result instead)

DOMAIN-SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS:
- lesson-scoping: No topic required, supports uiLanguage parameter (en-US, sv-SE, de-DE, etc.)
- expert-data-collection: Requires topic from lesson-scoping output
- lesson-generator: Requires topics from both lesson-scoping AND expert-data-collection
- video-transcript-generator: Requires topics from both lesson-scoping AND expert-data-collection

COMPARISON WITH SIMILAR TOOLS:
- Use THIS tool when: Starting a brand new session
- Use continue-evalab-chat when: Session exists and is not complete
- Use get-evalab-session when: Checking status of existing session
- Use get-session-result when: Session is complete and you need the result

RETURNS:
- sessionId: string - Unique identifier for continuing conversation
- response: string - AI's initial response
- tasks: object - Task progression (totalTasks, completedTasks, taskDetails)
- isComplete: boolean - Whether workflow is complete
- hasResult: boolean - Whether result is available

COMMON ERRORS:
- "Domain not found": Invalid domain identifier (use list-evalab-domains)
- "Topic required": Domain requires topic parameter but none provided
- "Language parameter not supported": uiLanguage only works with lesson-scoping domain
- "Invalid profile": profileId does not exist (use list-profiles)
- "Timeout": Request exceeded time limit (default varies by domain)

domain.description: Domain identifier (e.g., 'lesson-scoping', 'question-generation'). Use list-evalab-domains to discover available domains

message.description: Initial message to send. Can be empty for domain's default start behavior (default: 'Start session')

topic.description: Topic string from lesson-scoping output. Required for topic-consumer domains (expert-data-collection, lesson-generator, video-transcript-generator). Use list-available-topics to discover valid topics (default: none)

profileId.description: Expert profile ID to use for this session. Uses domain's default profile if omitted. Use list-profiles to discover available profiles (default: domain default profile)

uiLanguage.description: UI language code (e.g., 'en-US', 'sv-SE', 'de-DE', 'it-IT', 'es-ES'). ONLY supported for 'lesson-scoping' domain, ignored for others (default: none)

apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for evalab API (default: http://localhost:3000)

timeout.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. Auto-detected per domain: lesson-scoping=120s, expert-data-collection=180s, lesson-generator=300s (default: varies by domain)

tools.name: continueEvalabChatTool
tools.description:
Continue an existing chat session by sending another message. Sessions maintain context across multiple turns and track progress through domain tasks. Use this for multi-turn conversations until the workflow completes.

⚠️  VALIDATION ERRORS: This tool returns validation errors when the LLM generates invalid output. Always check hasValidationErrors in the response before assuming success. Validation errors indicate schema violations, invalid task states, or content integrity failures.

MULTI-TURN CONVERSATION PATTERN:
1. Send message with continue-evalab-chat
2. Receive AI response and updated task progress
3. Check isComplete flag
4. If false: Continue conversation (repeat from step 1)
5. If true and hasResult=true: Get result with get-session-result

USE THIS WHEN:
- Session exists and is not complete (isComplete=false)
- Need to provide more information to the AI
- Answering follow-up questions from the AI
- Progressing through multi-step workflow
- Session requires additional user input

DO NOT USE WHEN:
- Session is complete (isComplete=true) - use get-session-result instead
- Starting new conversation - use start-evalab-chat instead
- Just checking status without sending message - use get-evalab-session instead

COMPLETION DETECTION:
Check the response to determine next action:
- isComplete=false, hasResult=false → Continue sending messages
- isComplete=true, hasResult=true → Workflow done, get result
- isComplete=true, hasResult=false → Processing result, check again soon

COMPARISON WITH SIMILAR TOOLS:
- Use THIS tool when: Session active, need to send message
- Use start-evalab-chat when: Starting brand new session
- Use get-evalab-session when: Checking status without sending message
- Use get-session-result when: Session complete, need the output

RETURNS:
- response: string - AI's response to your message
- tasks: object - Updated task progress (totalTasks, completedTasks, taskDetails with validation errors)
- isComplete: boolean - Whether all tasks are complete
- hasResult: boolean - Whether result is available (use get-session-result when true)
- hasValidationErrors: boolean - Quick check for validation errors
- validationSummary: object - Error counts and summary
- integrityIssues: array - Detailed validation problems
- errorReportFilename: string - Error report filename for detailed diagnostics

COMMON ERRORS:
- "Session not found": Invalid sessionId or session expired
- "Session already complete": Cannot continue completed session (use get-session-result)
- "Message required": Cannot send empty message
- "Timeout": Request exceeded time limit (default 120000ms)

message.description: Your response or additional information to send to the AI

profileId.description: Override expert profile for this message only. Uses session's original profile if omitted (default: session profile)

apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for evalab API (default: http://localhost:3000)

timeout.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. Auto-detected per domain (default: 120000ms for most domains)

tools.name: getEvalabSessionTool
tools.description:
Get detailed information about a session including state, task progress, and optionally message history or system prompt. Use this to check if a session is complete and has generated a result before calling get-session-result. Essential for monitoring workflow progress without sending messages.

SESSION STATES:
- Active: isCompleted=false → Continue sending messages with continue-evalab-chat
- Complete with result: isCompleted=true, hasResult=true → Get result with get-session-result
- Complete pending result: isCompleted=true, hasResult=false → Result being generated, check again

USE THIS TO:
- Check if session is complete before getting result
- Monitor task progression without sending messages
- Review conversation history for debugging
- Verify session state before continuing
- Debug session issues with system prompt

USE THIS WHEN:
- Want to check status without sending a message
- Need to verify result is ready
- Monitoring task progress
- Debugging session behavior
- Checking completion before calling get-session-result

DO NOT USE WHEN:
- Want to send a message (use continue-evalab-chat instead)
- Want to start new session (use start-evalab-chat instead)
- Want to retrieve result (use get-session-result instead)
- Browsing multiple sessions (use list-evalab-sessions instead)

INCLUDE PARAMETERS:
- includeMessages (default: false): Include full message history. Set true for debugging or conversation analysis. Increases response size significantly.
- includeTasks (default: true): Include detailed task breakdown. Set false for faster queries when you only need completion status.
- includeSystemPrompt (default: false): Include compiled system prompt. Set true for troubleshooting prompt issues. Very large response.

COMPARISON WITH SIMILAR TOOLS:
- Use THIS tool when: Checking status without sending message
- Use continue-evalab-chat when: Sending message to session
- Use get-session-result when: Session complete, need output
- Use list-evalab-sessions when: Finding or browsing sessions

RETURNS:
- session: object - Session metadata (domain, isCompleted, hasResult, messageCount, timestamps)
- tasks: array - Task details if includeTasks=true (id, title, status, isValid)
- messages: array - Conversation history if includeMessages=true (role, content, timestamp)
- systemPrompt: string - Compiled prompt if includeSystemPrompt=true

COMMON ERRORS:
- "Session not found": Invalid sessionId or session expired
- "Unauthorized": Invalid API credentials

sessionId.description: Session ID to retrieve information for

includeMessages.description: Include full conversation history. Set true for debugging or analysis. Increases response size (default: false)

includeTasks.description: Include detailed task breakdown with individual task statuses. Set false for faster queries when only need completion flag (default: true)

includeSystemPrompt.description: Include compiled system prompt text. Set true for troubleshooting prompt issues. Very large response (default: false)

apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for evalab API (default: http://localhost:3000)

tools.name: listEvalabSessionsTool
tools.description:
List and filter chat sessions across domains with pagination and sorting. Essential for managing multiple concurrent sessions, finding sessions with completed results, reviewing recent activity, or discovering abandoned sessions.

USE THIS TO:
- Find all sessions for a specific domain
- List sessions with completed results
- Check recent activity across all domains
- Discover abandoned or incomplete sessions
- Monitor session progress across workflows
- Page through large numbers of sessions

USE THIS WHEN:
- Need to browse or search for sessions
- Finding sessions by status or result availability
- Reviewing recent activity
- Managing multiple concurrent workflows
- Looking for specific sessions to continue

DO NOT USE WHEN:
- Checking specific session details (use get-evalab-session instead)
- Want to send message to session (use continue-evalab-chat instead)
- Need result from known session (use get-session-result instead)

FILTERING OPTIONS:
- domain: Filter by specific domain (e.g., 'lesson-scoping')
- status: 'active' (not complete), 'completed' (workflow done), 'all' (default)
- hasResult: true (has generated output), false (no output), undefined (any)
- sortBy: 'lastActivity' (default), 'created', 'messageCount'
- sortOrder: 'desc' (newest first, default), 'asc' (oldest first)

PAGINATION:
- Use limit + offset for paging through results
- Check hasMore in pagination response for more results
- Maximum 100 sessions per request

COMPARISON WITH SIMILAR TOOLS:
- Use THIS tool when: Browsing, searching, or filtering sessions
- Use get-evalab-session when: Getting details for specific session
- Use continue-evalab-chat when: Interacting with specific session
- Use get-session-result when: Retrieving output from session

RETURNS:
- sessions: array - Session summaries with status, results, message counts
- pagination: object - total, returned, limit, offset, hasMore

COMMON ERRORS:
- "Invalid status": status must be 'active', 'completed', or 'all'
- "Limit exceeds maximum": limit must be between 1 and 100
- "Invalid sortBy": sortBy must be 'created', 'lastActivity', or 'messageCount'

domain.description: Filter by specific domain (e.g., 'lesson-scoping', 'lesson-generator'). Omit for all domains (default: all domains)

status.description: Filter by completion status: 'active' (incomplete), 'completed' (workflow done), 'all' (any status). (default: 'all')

hasResult.description: Filter by result availability: true (has output), false (no output), undefined (any). Use true to find sessions ready for get-session-result (default: any)

offset.description: Pagination offset - number of results to skip. For page 2 with limit=20, use offset=20 (default: 0)

sortBy.description: Sort field: 'lastActivity' (most recent activity), 'created' (creation time), 'messageCount' (conversation length). (default: 'lastActivity')

tools.name: getSessionResultTool
tools.description:
Retrieve the output generated by a completed session. Domains produce structured JSON results when workflows complete (e.g., lesson-scoping outputs lesson plans, lesson-generator outputs full lessons). Supports two retrieval modes: by specific sessionId OR latest result for a domain.

RETRIEVAL MODES:
1. By Session ID: Get result for specific session
   - Use sessionId parameter
   - Omit domain and latest parameters

2. By Latest: Get most recent result for any domain
   - Use domain + latest=true parameters
   - Omit sessionId parameter

USE THIS WHEN:
- Session is complete (isComplete=true, hasResult=true)
- Need to retrieve generated output
- Want most recent result for testing/development
- Chaining results to next domain (e.g., lesson-scoping → expert-data-collection)

DO NOT USE WHEN:
- Session not complete yet (check with get-evalab-session first)
- Just checking status (use get-evalab-session instead)
- Continuing conversation (use continue-evalab-chat instead)

RESULT FORMATS BY DOMAIN:
- lesson-scoping: Lesson scope with goals, audience, behaviors, topic
- expert-data-collection: Expert insights and interview data
- lesson-generator: Complete lesson with activities and content
- video-transcript-generator: Video transcript with timing and metadata
- question-generation: Quiz questions with answers and explanations

COMPARISON WITH SIMILAR TOOLS:
- Use THIS tool when: Session complete, need the output
- Use get-evalab-session when: Checking if result is ready
- Use continue-evalab-chat when: Session not complete
- Use list-domain-results when: Browsing all results for a domain

RETURNS:
- result: object - Domain-specific structured data (JSON)
- resultInfo: object - Metadata (fileName, sessionId, domain, topic, created, size)

COMMON ERRORS:
- "Must provide either sessionId or domain": No parameters provided
- "When using domain parameter, latest must be set to true": Missing latest flag
- "Session not found": Invalid sessionId or session doesn't exist
- "No result available": Session incomplete or result not generated yet
- "Result file not found": Result was deleted or never created

sessionId.description: Session ID to retrieve result for. Use this when you know which specific session you want. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with domain parameter (default: none)

domain.description: Domain identifier to retrieve latest result from (e.g., 'lesson-scoping', 'lesson-generator'). MUST be combined with latest=true. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with sessionId (default: none)

latest.description: Set to true when using domain parameter to get most recent result. Ignored when using sessionId (default: false)

apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for evalab API (default: http://localhost:3000)

tools.name: listDomainResultsTool
tools.description:
List all completed sessions and generated results for a specific domain. Returns result metadata without loading full content. Essential for discovering what results are available before retrieving full data.

USE THIS WHEN:
- Browsing results for a domain
- Finding results by topic or date
- Checking result metadata without loading content
- Monitoring domain output over time
- Discovering available results

DO NOT USE WHEN:
- Need full result content (use get-session-result)
- Want single specific result (use get-session-result with sessionId)
- Checking session status (use get-evalab-session)

PAGINATION:
- limit (default: 10, max: 100): Results per page
- offset (default: 0): Results to skip
- Check hasMore for additional pages

COMPARISON WITH SIMILAR TOOLS:
- Use THIS tool when: Browsing results, checking metadata
- Use get-session-result when: Need full result content
- Use list-evalab-sessions when: Browsing sessions (not just results)

RETURNS:
- results: array - Result metadata (fileName, topic, domain, created, size, sessionId)
- pagination: object - total, returned, offset, limit, hasMore

COMMON ERRORS:
- "Domain not found": Invalid domain (use list-evalab-domains)
- "Limit exceeds maximum": limit must be 1-100

domain.description: Domain identifier to list results for (e.g., 'lesson-scoping', 'question-generation')

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (valid range: 1-100, default: 10)

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (must be non-negative)

tools.name: getTopicFromSessionTool
tools.description:
Extract the topic generated by a completed session. Topics flow between domains in multi-domain workflows - extract from one session to use in the next.

TOPIC FLOW WORKFLOW:
1. Complete lesson-scoping session
2. Extract topic with this tool
3. Use topic for expert-data-collection
4. Extract expert topic
5. Use both topics for lesson-generator or video-transcript-generator

USE THIS WHEN:
- Session is complete (isCompleted=true, hasResult=true)
- Need to chain session result to next domain
- Extracting topic for downstream workflow
- Verifying topic was generated successfully

DO NOT USE WHEN:
- Session not complete yet (check with get-evalab-session first)
- Just browsing available topics (use list-available-topics)
- Domain doesn't produce topics

DOMAIN TYPES:
- Topic producers: lesson-scoping (generates lesson topic)
- Topic consumers & producers: expert-data-collection (consumes lesson topic, produces expert topic)
- Topic consumers only: lesson-generator, video-transcript-generator (consume both topics)

COMPARISON WITH SIMILAR TOOLS:
- Use THIS tool when: Extracting topic from completed session
- Use list-available-topics when: Browsing all available topics
- Use get-session-result when: Need full result content (not just topic)

RETURNS:
- topic: string - Generated topic content
- sessionInfo: object - Session metadata (domain, completion status)

COMMON ERRORS:
- "Session not found": Invalid sessionId
- "Session not complete": Session hasn't finished (use get-evalab-session to check)
- "No result available": Session complete but result not generated
- "Domain does not generate topics": Domain doesn't produce topics

tools.name: getErrorReportTool
tools.description:
Retrieve detailed error report for comprehensive validation diagnostics.

WHEN TO USE THIS:
- Session response includes errorReportFilename field
- Need full diagnostics beyond integrityIssues summary
- Investigating why LLM output failed validation
- Analyzing schema violations or task integrity problems
- Troubleshooting complex validation errors

WHAT YOU GET:
The error report contains plain text with:
- Session metadata (ID, domain, timestamp, response size)
- Schema validation errors (field violations, type mismatches, length limits)
- Task integrity errors (invalid states, relationship violations)
- Full LLM response (raw and parsed for debugging)
- Fix suggestions and recommendations

ERROR CHECKING WORKFLOW:
1. Call start-evalab-chat or continue-evalab-chat
2. Check response.hasValidationErrors
3. If true, read response.validationSummary.summaryText for overview
4. Review response.integrityIssues for specific errors
5. If response.errorReportFilename exists, call THIS tool for full diagnostics
6. Use error report content to understand and fix validation issues

EXAMPLE WORKFLOW:
const session = await continueEvalabChatTool({ sessionId, message });
if (session.hasValidationErrors) {
  console.log(session.validationSummary.summaryText);
  // "Found 2 errors in schema validation"

  if (session.errorReportFilename) {
    const report = await getErrorReportTool({
      filename: session.errorReportFilename
    });
    console.log(report.content);  // Full diagnostic details
  }
}

COMMON ERRORS:
- "Invalid filename format": Filename doesn't match error_session-{id}_{timestamp}.txt pattern
- "Error report not found": File was deleted or never generated (try again or contact support)

RETURNS:
- content: string - Plain text error report with full diagnostics
- filename: string - Filename that was retrieved (echo of input)
- size: number - File size in bytes (typically 2-50 KB)
- createdAt: string - When error report was created (ISO 8601 format)

filename.description: Error report filename from session response errorReportFilename field. Format: error_session-{sessionId}_{timestamp}.txt. Example: error_session-abc123_2026-02-19T16-12-07-955Z.txt

apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for evalab API (default: http://localhost:3000)

tools.name: listEvalabDomainsTool
tools.description:
List all available evalab domains with their configurations. Domains are AI workflows for specific tasks - each has unique input requirements, completion criteria, and output formats. Essential first step for discovering what workflows are available.

WHAT ARE DOMAINS?
Domains are specialized AI workflows:
- lesson-scoping: Creates lesson outlines and scopes (produces topic)
- expert-data-collection: Gathers expert insights (consumes topic, produces expert topic)
- lesson-generator: Creates complete lessons (consumes both topics)
- video-transcript-generator: Generates video transcripts (consumes both topics)

USE THIS WHEN:
- Starting work and need to discover available workflows
- Checking what domains exist before using start-evalab-chat
- Understanding domain capabilities and requirements
- Planning multi-domain workflows
- Verifying domain IDs before use

DO NOT USE WHEN:
- Need detailed info about specific domain (use inspect-domain or get-evalab-domain-info)
- Need topics list (use inspect-domain or list-available-topics)
- Already know which domain to use

DOMAIN METADATA RETURNED:
- id: Domain identifier for start-evalab-chat
- name: Human-readable name
- description: What the domain does
- inputSources: Required inputs from other domains (if any)
- completionType: 'task-based' (tasks define completion) or 'result-based' (result generation defines completion)

COMPARISON WITH SIMILAR TOOLS:
- Use THIS tool when: Discovering all available domains
- Use inspect-domain when: Need detailed info about one domain
- Use get-evalab-domain-info when: Need quick config for one domain

RETURNS:
- domains: array - All available domains with metadata
- totalDomains: number - Count of domains

COMMON ERRORS:
- "Unauthorized": Invalid API credentials
- "Service unavailable": API server not running

tools.name: getEvalabDomainInfoTool
tools.description:
Get basic configuration for a specific domain quickly. Returns essential domain setup information without topics or profiles list. Lighter-weight and faster than inspect-domain.

USE THIS WHEN:
- Need basic domain configuration quickly
- Just checking domain settings before starting session
- Don't need topics or profiles lists
- Want fast response with minimal data

USE inspect-domain INSTEAD WHEN:
- Need available topics list
- Need compatible profiles list
- Want comprehensive domain analysis
- Planning which topic to use

WHAT'S INCLUDED:
- Domain ID, name, and description
- Input requirements (inputSources)
- Completion type (task-based vs result-based)
- Default settings (roleType, timezone)
- Static template variables
- Content loader configuration

COMPARISON WITH SIMILAR TOOLS:
- Use THIS tool when: Quick config lookup
- Use inspect-domain when: Need topics/profiles or comprehensive info
- Use list-evalab-domains when: Browsing all domains

RETURNS:
- domain: object - Domain configuration with all settings

COMMON ERRORS:
- "Domain not found": Invalid domain identifier (use list-evalab-domains)

domain.description: Domain identifier to get information for

tools.name: listAvailableTopicsTool
tools.description:
List topics available for topic-consumer domains. Topics are generated by source domains and consumed by downstream domains in multi-domain workflows.

TOPIC FLOW:
- lesson-scoping → generates topics
- expert-data-collection → consumes lesson-scoping topics, generates expert topics
- lesson-generator → consumes both topics
- video-transcript-generator → consumes both topics

USE THIS WHEN:
- Discovering what topics are available for a domain
- Planning which topic to use with start-evalab-chat
- Checking if required topics exist
- Understanding topic requirements before starting session

DO NOT USE WHEN:
- Extracting topic from specific session (use get-topic-from-session)
- Need comprehensive domain info (use inspect-domain which includes topics)
- Just checking domain config (use get-evalab-domain-info)

COMPARISON WITH SIMILAR TOOLS:
- Use THIS tool when: Just need topics list for a domain
- Use inspect-domain when: Need topics plus other domain info
- Use get-topic-from-session when: Extracting topic from completed session

RETURNS:
- topics: array - Available topics with displayName, sourceFile, domain
- totalTopics: number - Count of topics
- requiredSources: array - What domains produce required topics

COMMON ERRORS:
- "Domain not found": Invalid domain
- "Domain does not consume topics": Domain doesn't need topics

domain.description: Domain identifier to list topics for
